title: 芝加哥深隧道與水庫計畫~Chicago Tunnel and Reservoir Plan
focus: 隧道與大型水庫的事件調蓄~Event storage in tunnels and reservoirs
summary: TARP展示如何把暴雨期間的混合水暫存，於能力允許時送回處理。學徒需建立前一場雨尚未排空的連續事件情境。~TARP illustrates storing combined flows during storms and returning them for treatment when capacity permits. The learner must model consecutive events before storage has emptied.

units.title: 服務集水區降雨：集水面積與逕流量~Service-catchment rainfall: Catchment area and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「服務集水區降雨」觀察此因果關係。~Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at service-catchment rainfall.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
units.verify: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「服務集水區降雨」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for service-catchment rainfall; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總雨量相同就保證尖峰淹水風險相同。~Equal storm totals guarantee equal peak flood risk.
units.practice: 先點選「服務集水區降雨」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the service-catchment rainfall measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 截流系統瓶頸：尖峰流量與可用能力~Interceptor bottleneck: Peak flow and available capacity
units.mechanism: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「截流系統瓶頸」觀察此因果關係。~Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Examine this relationship at interceptor bottleneck.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：平均 Q=0.8 m³/s、假設尖峰係數 f=2.5。公式 Qp=fQ；代入 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s。適用邊界：係數為假設，不能代替地方降雨與下水道時序分析。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: mean Q=0.8 m³/s and assumed peak factor f=2.5. Formula Qp=fQ; substitution 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s. Boundary: The assumed factor does not replace local rainfall and sewer time-series analysis.
units.verify: 把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「截流系統瓶頸」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for interceptor bottleneck; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 平均流量通過即可證明暴雨時不溢流。~Passing mean flow proves that storm overflows cannot occur.
units.practice: 先點選「截流系統瓶頸」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把尖峰係數改成3，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 m³/s。與基準 2 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the interceptor bottleneck measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only the peak factor to3 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 m³/s. Compare with baseline 2 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 隧道水庫共同儲量：調蓄與連續方程~Combined tunnel/reservoir storage: Storage and continuity
units.mechanism: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「隧道水庫共同儲量」觀察此因果關係。~Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at combined tunnel/reservoir storage.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
units.verify: 以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「隧道水庫共同儲量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for combined tunnel/reservoir storage; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 最大容積等於每場雨都可用的容積。~Maximum volume equals the available volume for every storm.
units.practice: 先點選「隧道水庫共同儲量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the combined tunnel/reservoir storage measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 連續暴雨間退水：退水時間與恢復使用~Interstorm drawdown: Drawdown time and return to use
units.mechanism: 暫存水需在下次事件前排空並確認使用條件；退水時間由可用排水流量決定。本單元在「連續暴雨間退水」觀察此因果關係。~Stored water needs drawdown before the next event and a check before public use; available discharge governs drawdown time. Examine this relationship at interstorm drawdown.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待排水V=180 m³、定流量Q=15 m³/h。公式 t=V/Q；代入 180/15 = 12 h。適用邊界：固定出流示範；孔口出流隨水頭下降須積分計算。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: stored waterV=180 m³ and constant dischargeQ=15 m³/h. Formula t=V/Q; substitution 180/15 = 12 h. Boundary: Constant-flow illustration; orifice discharge declining with head needs integration.
units.verify: 以水位記錄核對退水曲線，巡查積水與污物後才恢復場地。在離線場景為「連續暴雨間退水」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check the drawdown curve against level data and inspect standing water and debris before reopening. Build an offline evidence table for interstorm drawdown; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 出水口被落葉堵塞會延長不可用時間。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Leaf-blocked outlets lengthen unavailable time. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 雨停後場地一定立刻可安全使用。~A space is necessarily ready for safe use immediately when rain stops.
units.practice: 先點選「連續暴雨間退水」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q降成10 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 18 h。與基準 12 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the interstorm drawdown measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only Q to10 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 18 h. Compare with baseline 12 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 回送污水處理：提升水頭與電力~Return pumping to treatment: Lift head and electrical power
units.mechanism: 泵的輸入功率須供應流量的位能增加及損失；效率下降會使同一輸送服務耗電增加。本單元在「回送污水處理」觀察此因果關係。~Pump input must provide the hydraulic energy increase and losses; lower efficiency increases electricity for the same conveyance service. Examine this relationship at return pumping to treatment.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=0.10 m³/s、H=12 m、總效率η=0.72、ρ=1000 kg/m³。公式 P=ρgQH/(1000η)；代入 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW。適用邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，H含管損；不涵蓋起動、水錘與汽蝕。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=0.10 m³/s, H=12 m, total efficiencyη=0.72 and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Formula P=ρgQH/(1000η); substitution 1000*9.81*0.10*12/(1000*0.72) = 16.35 kW. Boundary: Steady incompressible flow with friction included in H; starting, surge and cavitation are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「回送污水處理」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for return pumping to treatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同流量下所有泵的耗電都相同。~All pumps consume the same power at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「回送污水處理」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the return pumping to treatment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 調蓄污染質量：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Stored pollutant mass: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「調蓄污染質量」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at stored pollutant mass.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「調蓄污染質量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for stored pollutant mass; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「調蓄污染質量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the stored pollutant mass measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 庫內沉積觀察：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Reservoir sedimentation observation: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「庫內沉積觀察」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at reservoir sedimentation observation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「庫內沉積觀察」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for reservoir sedimentation observation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「庫內沉積觀察」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the reservoir sedimentation observation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 庫水位及雨量對時：感測器偏移校正~Reservoir/rainfall timing: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「庫水位及雨量對時」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at reservoir/rainfall timing.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「庫水位及雨量對時」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for reservoir/rainfall timing; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「庫水位及雨量對時」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the reservoir/rainfall timing measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 暴雨中泵組退出：備援與共同失效~Pump unavailability during storms: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「暴雨中泵組退出」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at pump unavailability during storms.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「暴雨中泵組退出」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for pump unavailability during storms; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「暴雨中泵組退出」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the pump unavailability during storms measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 工程前後水質對照：前後與對照地點比較~Before-after water-quality comparison: Before-after and control comparison
units.mechanism: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「工程前後水質對照」觀察此因果關係。~Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at before-after water-quality comparison.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
units.verify: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「工程前後水質對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for before-after water-quality comparison; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。~Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
units.practice: 先點選「工程前後水質對照」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the before-after water-quality comparison measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: MWRD將TARP描述為深大直徑隧道與水庫系統，目的包括減少淹水與合流溢流污染。~MWRD describes TARP as deep large-diameter tunnels and reservoirs intended to reduce flooding and combined-sewer overflow pollution.

單元2基準：截流系統瓶頸~Unit2 baseline: interceptor bottleneck
單元2變量實驗：只把尖峰係數改成3~Unit2 changed-input experiment: change only the peak factor to3

單元3變量實驗：只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s~Unit3 changed-input experiment: increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s
單元4基準：連續暴雨間退水~Unit4 baseline: interstorm drawdown
單元4變量實驗：只把Q降成10 m³/h~Unit4 changed-input experiment: reduce only Q to10 m³/h
單元5基準：回送污水處理~Unit5 baseline: return pumping to treatment
單元5變量實驗：只把效率降成0.60~Unit5 changed-input experiment: reduce only efficiency to0.60
單元6基準：調蓄污染質量~Unit6 baseline: stored pollutant mass
單元6變量實驗：只把流量改成1500 m³/d~Unit6 changed-input experiment: change only flow to1500 m³/d
單元7基準：庫內沉積觀察~Unit7 baseline: reservoir sedimentation observation
單元7變量實驗：只把面積加至400 m²~Unit7 changed-input experiment: increase only area to400 m²
單元8基準：庫水位及雨量對時~Unit8 baseline: reservoir/rainfall timing
單元8變量實驗：只把樣品原讀值改成16.2~Unit8 changed-input experiment: change only raw sample to16.2
單元9基準：暴雨中泵組退出~Unit9 baseline: pump unavailability during storms
單元9變量實驗：只把各列A改成0.90~Unit9 changed-input experiment: change only each train availability to0.90
單元10基準：工程前後水質對照~Unit10 baseline: before-after water-quality comparison
